reference: I wish my cat were as calm as that orange one in her arms.
sk: Kiež by môj kocúr bol taký pokojný ako ten ryšavý v jej náručí.
cz: Kéž by můj kocour byl tak klidný jako ten zrzavý v jejím náručí.
acceptable: I wish my cat were as {calm|relaxed} as {that|the} {orange|ginger} {one|cat} in her arms.
If only my cat were as {calm|relaxed} as {that|the} {orange|ginger} {one|cat} in her arms.

mistakes.text: I wish my cat was as {calm|relaxed} as that {orange|ginger} one in her arms.
mistakes.feedback_sk: V hovorovej reči sa „was“ používa, no po „wish“ je štandardné „were“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: V hovorové řeči se „was“ používá, ale po „wish“ je standardní „were“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Was” is common in speech, but after “wish” the standard form is “were”.

mistakes.text: I wish my cat is as {calm|relaxed} as that {orange|ginger} one in her arms.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „wish“ o prítomnosti patrí minulý tvar: „were“, nie „is“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „wish“ o přítomnosti patří minulý tvar: „were“, ne „is“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “wish” about the present use a past form: “were”, not “is”.

mistakes.text: I wish my cat would be as {calm|relaxed} as that {orange|ginger} one in her arms.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Wish + would“ je pre zmenu správania. Pri stave je prirodzenejšie „were“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Wish + would“ je pro změnu chování. U stavu je přirozenější „were“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Wish + would” is for changes in behaviour; for a state, “were” is more natural.

mistakes.text: I wish my cat were so {calm|relaxed} as that {orange|ginger} one in her arms.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Taký…ako“ je v kladnej vete „as…as“: „as calm as“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Tak…jako“ je v kladné větě „as…as“: „as calm as“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In a positive comparison use “as…as”: “as calm as”.

mistakes.text: I wish my cat were as {calm|relaxed} like that {orange|ginger} one in her arms.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Porovnanie „as…as“ sa uzatvára „as“, nie „like“: „as calm as“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Srovnání „as…as“ se uzavírá „as“, ne „like“: „as calm as“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The comparison “as…as” ends with “as”, not “like”: “as calm as”.

mistakes.text: I wish my cat had been as {calm|relaxed} as that {orange|ginger} one in her arms.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Had been“ je želanie o minulosti. Ide o prítomnosť, preto „were“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Had been“ je přání o minulosti. Jde o přítomnost, proto „were“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Had been” is a wish about the past; this is about now, so use “were”.
